title: Behind the scenes: a signed contract now remembers which agreements it contains
text: Nothing changes for any client until the "several agreements in one contract" switch is turned on. From then on, an offer with two services (for example a company closure and a tax return) is signed once and the contract records which agreements were in it, so the company page and the contact card say "Closure + Tax return agreements" instead of naming only the offer's main service. Contracts signed before this keep the name they always had. If the switch is changed while a client has the contract open, the client is asked to reload instead of signing a different document than the one on screen.
